scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @leetcollab/contracts build && concurrently -n realtime,web -c magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter @leetcollab/realtime dev" "pnpm --filter @leetcollab/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @leetcollab/contracts build && pnpm --filter @leetcollab/realtime build && pnpm --filter @leetcollab/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @leetcollab/contracts build && pnpm --filter @leetcollab/realtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @leetcollab/web typecheck
